caption_final:
Grand Theft Auto VI pre-loading opened today, 10 November. On PS5 it began at 12:00 am IST (midnight local time); on Xbox Series X|S at 5:30 am IST (12 am GMT).

Rockstar says the pre-load file needs up to 212 GB, depending on your console, so clear space before you start it.

The game launches on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; PlayStation and Xbox store listings in India show it unlocking at 12:00 am IST that day. In India, the Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition ₹7,499. Rockstar says code-in-box versions reach retailers from 12 November.

Are you starting at midnight on 19 November, or waiting for the first reviews?

Sources: Rockstar Games Newswire, Digit, Business Today
